comment: Solarized Light. Source: https://github.com/altercation/solarized (README.md, the scss snippet with the rebase mixin). Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2011 Ethan Schoonover; the text is in LICENSE-solarized. Roles: text = base00, weak = base1, rule = base2, accent = violet, run = blue, ok = green, error = red, add = green, remove = red, tint = base2, code = base3, background = base3. Solarized names one highlight background beyond the base, so rule and tint take it and code takes the base itself; a code block and a selected row do not look the same. Adjusted for contrast, nothing else changed: text #657b83 (base00) -> #5f747c: lightness 45% -> 43% for 4.5:1 on #fdf6e3 (was 4.13:1); weak #93a1a1 (base1) -> #829292: lightness 60% -> 54% for 3:1 on #fdf6e3 (was 2.48:1); ok #859900 (green) -> #819400: lightness 30% -> 29% for 3:1 on #fdf6e3 (was 2.97:1); add #859900 (green) -> #819400: lightness 30% -> 29% for 3:1 on #fdf6e3 (was 2.97:1).
